notes: This contract pins three bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 variant-record Discriminant Enumerator lexical rules: supplied fields contain comma-separated enumerators or bracketed two-endpoint ranges; HLAother is a standalone special symbol and may occur at most once per record. The completed-model preflight keeps an omitted field representable for incomplete DIF. Membership, table-order range expansion, cross-alternative overlap, and the HLAother complement model are intentionally covered by paired private contracts. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service evidence claim.
